description.en: Warren Buffett's most significant investments and their lessons
description.zh: 沃伦·巴菲特最重要的投资及其教训

investment_thesis.en: Global brand with pricing power, simple business, huge moat
investment_thesis.zh: 全球品牌，拥有定价权，简单业务，巨大护城河

major_investments.outcome: One of Buffett's best investments, still held
lessons: Brand power is a durable moat
Simple businesses are easier to understand

investment_thesis.en: Consumer electronics powerhouse with loyal customer base and ecosystem
investment_thesis.zh: 消费电子巨头，拥有忠实客户群和生态系统

investment_thesis.en: Low-cost insurance producer with direct-to-consumer model
investment_thesis.zh: 低成本保险生产商，直接面向消费者模式

lessons: Cost advantage is a durable moat

investment_thesis.en: Premium brand with network effects in payments
investment_thesis.zh: 高端品牌，在支付领域拥有网络效应

major_investments.outcome: Still held, one of longest-held positions

investment_thesis.en: Regional premium candy brand with pricing power
investment_thesis.zh: 地区高端糖果品牌，拥有定价权

lessons: Pricing power is key indicator of moat
Small acquisitions can teach big lessons

buffett_quote.en: If we had not made the See's acquisition, we would not have bought Coca-Cola in 1988.
buffett_quote.zh: 如果我们没有收购喜诗糖果，我们不会在1988年购买可口可乐。

investment_thesis.en: Dominant newspaper in a one-newspaper town
investment_thesis.zh: 在只有一个报纸的城市中占主导地位的报纸

investment_thesis.en: Well-managed bank at depressed price during real estate crisis
investment_thesis.zh: 在房地产危机期间价格低迷但管理良好的银行

mistake.en: Overpaid for a shoe company that lost competitive advantage
mistake.zh: 为一家失去竞争优势的鞋业公司支付过高价格

lesson.en: Never issue shares to make an acquisition - the math doesn't work
lesson.zh: 永远不要发行股票进行收购——数学上不划算

buffett_quote.en: Dexter was the worst purchase I've ever made.
buffett_quote.zh: 德克斯特是我做过的最糟糕的购买。

mistake.en: Bought oil company near peak of oil prices
mistake.zh: 在油价接近峰值时买入石油公司

lesson.en: Don't buy commodity businesses at peak prices
lesson.zh: 不要在价格峰值时买入大宗商品企业

mistake.en: Invested in airline industry, which has terrible economics
mistake.zh: 投资航空业，其经济学非常糟糕

lesson.en: Avoid commodity businesses with high capex and no pricing power
lesson.zh: 避免高资本支出且无定价权的大宗商品企业

early_phase.style: Cigar butt investing - buying cheap stocks regardless of quality

transition.catalyst: Charlie Munger's influence, See's Candies acquisition

mature_phase.style: Buying wonderful businesses at fair prices
